status: Protocol saved before forecasting; no future outcome retrieval. GitHub push before target dates provides an externally visible freeze. Scores remain pending.
eligibility: Only full daily targets strictly after the UTC issue date. Oct29/30 are archived but excluded from prospective scores. Forecast issue time differs from first-unseen origin; missing Oct29/30 context is an explicit data-lag limitation.
foundation_model: Exactly the TimesFM3 code/weight revision, verified SHA and settings in second_model_audit_v1; context730, CPU, native .1-.9 quantiles, no symmetry averaging
local_models: Same rich feature definition and grids as strong_refit_v1; for EACH lead1..14 choose parameters with the same pre-2026 180-day validation/purge; fit at Oct1 using preceding730 days with training labels through Sep30, and use daily causal history through Oct28 at Oct29 origin. No tuning on any 2026 error.
calendar: Ordinary weekday and annual harmonic features only. No unverified 2026 regional holiday inputs. Festival-specific subgroup analysis is secondary and conditional on independently verified 2026 event definitions; primary prospective scoring uses all eligible dates.
primary_metric: Mean state MAE divided by fixed pre-2026 730-day observed weekly-difference scale on identical eligible recorded targets; all six fixed configurations, no selected winner claim
probabilistic: TimesFM3 native .1-.9 pinball/80%coverage/width on eligible targets; no calibration to these future outcomes
limits: One forecast episode, correlated states and neighbouring days; weak generalisation evidence
Same source as historical work, not independent source replication
Historical method design exploratory; prospective outcomes alone not whole study confirmation
No scores or acceptance claims until outcomes acquired after dates with source hashes and retrieval timestamps
freeze_policy: Preserve protocol, predictions, issue timestamp and file hashes. Do not overwrite forecasts or choose feature/parameter settings after outcomes. Push immutable Git commit now, score later into a new directory with an actual-source audit.
